name: Source Carrier
abstract: A physical original document, photograph, drawing, negative or bound volume that carries heritage information, modelled as CIDOC-CRM E31 Document. Records the physical carrier from which digital surrogates are derived, with repository, archival code, and rights metadata.

sources.title: ISAD(G) General International Standard Archival Description
HERITALISE D8.2 REQ-012 (Original Historical Source Carrier)
